source.title: インペリアルクロス(Imperial Cross)
source.author: しゑひ(shiwehi)
source.fetch_method: curl through the session proxy, TLS verification ON, with --cacert naming a bundle that adds the Let's Encrypt YE2 intermediate (shiwehi.com omits it from its chain), the method STSD, STMB Cave, 山岳積み2号 and stick spin used. The snapshot is the page's raw HTML, byte for byte; every board is plain text in it, 14 ten-wide boards in page order.
source.snapshot_note: sha256 of the raw HTML this transcription was checked against. Not re-verifiable in CI: the page is not committed and cannot be fetched there. Re-check with --html-dir after any refetch; an HTML hash moves with ANY byte of the page (ads, sidebar, a date), so a moved hash means "read the board diff", not "the boards changed". Sentences are compared against the page with its tags dropped.

quotes.verbatim: ここでは、インペリアルクロス(Imperial Cross)という、TSDを2回打つことができる中盤テンプレについて紹介していきます。
基本形とラインの消し方
基本形は上図の通りです。
ここから、以下のように%Tを縦向きに入れてTSDを打つと、もう一度TSDを打てる形が残ります。
元地形からの組み方と特徴
1つ目の組み方としては、既に完成されたTSDの形から%Zや%Lを引っ掛けて作る方法です。
%Jが来た場合には代わりにTSTを組むことができます。
2つ目に、既に完成された十字形から%Zを乗せて作る方法です。
インペリアルクロスを組む代わりにダブルダガーを組むこともできます。

variants.window_note: in basic.spin's frame, row 0 the top: the AGREEMENT BOX of every drawing in `agreement` and ガムシロ積み's two Imperial Cross boards. Rows 3 and 5 are the rows the TSD clears (entailed by the clear at a full TSD, NaiveClauseForced); row 4 is the cross's middle row, its LEFT arm empty (column 1), which no T but this stood one leaves and which keeps the two cleared rows apart; rows 1-2 are the overhang: the stem's top cell has an empty cell over it, the nub's corner a filled one. Column 4 is outside: the top cell of it disagrees (empty here, the stood Z on tsd.oz, B on the basic form). Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled.

followup.drawn_note: the page draws basic.after before the stack right of the overhang is built: the flat T fills the bottom row there and not the one above it, whose cells right of the overhang are still empty. The TSD the page promises (もう一度TSDを打てる形) clears both once that side is stacked up, which is what the matcher scores.
followup.note: the flat T, pointing down, into the empty arm under the overhang (pre-clear: the row above the cross and the arm, two cleared rows apart). It lies inside the window; the matcher carries it through every clear to the next T.
